Unfortunately, the weather is bad.
Aug 2023 • Family
We had made a reservation in advance and were looking forward to a terrace seat, but it started to rain lightly that night.
We were told that the weather was going to get rough, so we had to sit inside.

The restaurant was empty, probably because it was a weekday, and there were a few people who looked to be hotel guests who had come to eat with meal tickets.

It felt more like a cafe than a restaurant.
I would recommend coming in the morning or afternoon, rather than for dinner.
(The terrace seats might be good if the weather was sunny...)

The fries and grilled shrimp were delicious.
Considering the atmosphere, it was a bit disappointing that the prices were for a hotel room.

Perhaps the restaurant terrace (pool view) near the Pullman lobby was better because it had a roof?

Highly skilled chefs at Azure: delicious dinner
Mar 2023 • Friends
Delicious, attractively plated, well-cooked food. I reckon the chefs at Azure are also those from the Pullman Da Nang’s breakfast buffet because the food is very good. The prices are high by Da Nang standards but it is reasonable given the quality of the cooking. 

Even though it was a little cool sitting outside by the beach in early March, it was the best option as you dine to the sound of the splashing waves. Lovely.

Recommended dishes: Grilled Calamari, Grouper Fish in Curry, Stir fried vegetables (side dish). Very nice plating. 

The best places we ate at in Da Nang were at the Pullman Da Nang (Azure and Epice).

Charming location, still overpriced
Aug 2019 • Family
Like other people said, the location is charming, right next to the sand. The hotel grounds are also pretty; it's nice to walk through them on the way to the restaurant. There is a big pool and nice sculptures of butterflies; we enjoyed the environment. We came around 8:30 on a week night, and there were only two other couples besides us. By the end, we were alone. So it's a good place to escape the hustle & bustle, but not a good place if you're looking to people watch or experience the city's liveliness. We ordered Vietnamese seafood curry, which was good. We also ordered squid cooked on a hot stone with pineapple juice. They cooked the squid right at the table, and it was fun to watch it, but it was not the tastiest squid we had in Vietnam. I wouldn't say it was worth the US$17 price tag, considering the prices in Vietnam. And the fruit plate was quite pathetic! We expected some interesting exotic fruit, but they only included watermelon, grapes, and some guava. Guava was good, but the rest was a bit mundane.

SUNDAY BBQ
Jul 2019 • Friends
더운날은 가지마세요.. 에어컨 시스템이 하나도 안돼있습니다.
전력도 약한지 가져온 선풍기도 하나 켜면 다른것들이 꺼집니다.
불은 어떻게 들어오는지 신기할 지경.

I was looking forward to having a pleasant evening by SUNDAY BBQ with my friends who came to Danang to meet me in two years.

When I went to the AZURE restaurant, staff asked me I had booked.. and I saw my table on the reservation list was fixed. Despite booking 4 days in advance, the staff provided dark corner seat. 

We felt hotter as soon as we sat down and asked for a change of seat, but did not allow it because it was a reserved seat.
(But the place I asked for was empty until the end of the meal)

The restaurant was getting hot&humidity. As soon as we complained to the staff, all kinds of complaints began to appear at the tables around us. 

It was like a disaster movie!!!!!

The staff only brought one big fan and could not accommodate all guests.

Complaints were even more intense..

After another guest told to bring the manager, the manager came to us. 
the restaurant manager apologized, but not all guests enjoyed their meals.

After the manager had gone, there were three fans, but they had to struggle to connect them. 
When one worked, the other two went out. Continue to repeat...

Is the restaurant at Pullman Resort ever operating this way everyday?

If not ready to operation, should not welcome guests. The restaurant, which is managed by Accor rather than the domestic company in Vietnam, did not even imagine that it would operate at such a low level.

Five Star Hotel Worst Terrible Experience

Exceeded our expectations
Jun 2019 • Couples
We dined here on our last night in Vietnam. We opted for oysters to start which were perfectly shucked and accompanied with shallots in red wine vinegar, plus lemon wedges, they were very flavoursome.

For the main course we went with the Vietnamese Seafood curry which had lots of different seafood and again great flavours without being too spicy, plus the Sea Bass, also very good.

Dessert was Baileys flavoured ice cream prepared at the table using dry ice in the process.

The house wine offered is from New Zealand, we tried the Sauvignon Blanc which was perfectly chilled and accompanied the seafood perfectly. Service throughout was very good with attentive staff, but not intrusive.

We would return for sure.
